products.name: 9-Piece Silicone Baby Feeding Set
products.short: Everything for mealtimes in one matching set: suction plate and bowl, sippy cup, waterproof bib and two sets of spoons and forks. BPA-free silicone in six soft colours.
products.description:
Make mealtimes easier (and a lot less messy) with this complete 9-piece feeding set. The divided plate and the bowl have large suction bases that grip the high chair tray, so they stay put when little hands get busy. The soft, waterproof bib has a deep pocket that catches the crumbs and adjusts as your baby grows.

It comes with two sets of spoons and forks: short chewy silicone ones with a choke guard for first self-feeding (they soothe sore gums too), and bigger wooden-handle ones for toddlers up to about 4 years. The sippy cup with straw lid helps little ones learn to drink by themselves.

Made of 100% food-grade silicone that is BPA-free, PVC-free and phthalate-free. It's microwave, dishwasher and fridge safe and can be sterilised in boiling water. Choose from pink, dusty rose, lilac, sage green, blue or beige.
features: 9 matching pieces for every meal, from first tastes to toddler
Plate and bowl with large suction bases that stay put on the tray
Divided plate keeps foods separate
Waterproof bib with a deep crumb-catcher pocket and adjustable neck
Sippy cup with straw lid
Chewy silicone spoon and fork with choke guard, plus wooden-handle spoon and fork for toddlers up to about 48 months
100% food-grade silicone: BPA-free, PVC-free and phthalate-free
Microwave, dishwasher and fridge safe; can be sterilised in boiling water
Sizes: bib 23 x 30 cm, plate 19.5 cm across, bowl 11.5 cm across, cup 7.5 x 7 cm
inTheBox: 1 x Sippy cup with straw lid
1 x Chewy silicone spoon and 1 x fork
1 x Wooden-handle spoon and 1 x fork
products.age: For babies starting solids and toddlers. Always stay with your child while they eat, and press the suction bases onto a clean, flat, smooth surface. Check the pieces before each use and replace any that are damaged.

products.name: Silicone Baby Fruit Feeder 2-Pack with Mini Freezer Tray
products.short: Two bear-handle fruit feeders with teats in 3 sizes, plus a freezer tray for breastmilk popsicles. Safe self-feeding and cool relief for teething gums.
products.description:
Let your little one explore real food safely. Pop fresh fruit or soft vegetables into the silicone teat and baby can suck, chew and gum away at it, getting all the taste while bigger pieces stay inside the feeder.

When teething makes gums sore, freeze breastmilk, formula or fruit purée in the freezer tray and pop a cube into the feeder for cool, soothing relief. The little bear handle is easy for small hands to hold, so baby can feed themselves while you enjoy your meal too.

The feeders grow with your baby: swap between small, medium and large teats as they move from first tastes to bigger bites. Everything comes apart for easy cleaning and is dishwasher, hand-wash and boil safe.
features: 2 x fruit feeders with cute bear handles, in green and blue
Food-grade silicone teats in 3 sizes: S (4 to 6 months), M (6 to 9 months), L (10 to 24 months+)
Freezer tray with lid for breastmilk, formula or purée popsicles
Cool frozen treats soothe sore, teething gums
Silicone sealing ring and protective lid keep it clean in the nappy bag
Comes apart for cleaning: dishwasher, hand-wash and boil safe
inTheBox: 2 x Fruit feeders with bear handles (green and blue)
6 x Silicone teats: 2 small, 2 medium, 2 large
products.age: From 4 months: use the size S teat from 4 to 6 months, M from 6 to 9 months and L from 10 months. Ask your clinic when your baby is ready for solids. Wash everything before first use, always stay with your baby while they use the feeder, and check the teat before each use: replace it if it's torn or worn.

products.name: Baby Support Chair, Pink Cat Design
products.short: A soft, cuddly infant seat with a cute pink cat face that helps your little one sit up, play and see the world.
products.description:
Once your baby can hold their head up, they want to sit up and join in. This plush support chair gives them a cosy, padded seat with a high backrest and rounded armrests that wrap around their body, so they can sit upright while they play, watch you or practise their balance.

The pink cat face, little paws and striped lining make it a sweet addition to any nursery or lounge, and it's light enough to move from room to room. It makes a lovely baby shower gift too.
features: Soft plush seat with a high, padded backrest
Rounded armrests that wrap around baby for support
Two leg openings so baby sits comfortably
Cute pink cat face, paws and “Spoil you” embroidery
Lightweight, so it's easy to move around the house
inTheBox: 1 x Baby Support Chair, Pink Cat Design
products.age: For babies who can hold their head up steadily. Check the age and weight guidance on the packaging. Only use it on the floor, never on a table, bed, sofa or other raised surface, and never near water. Always stay with your baby while they use it, and don't let them sleep in it.

products.name: Talking Cactus
products.short: The cheeky dancing cactus that repeats what you say, sings, sways and lights up. Giggles guaranteed.
products.description:
Press the button and the Talking Cactus sings, sways to the music and lights up in bright colours. Press again for the next song. Pause the music, say something, and it repeats it right back in a funny voice.

Little ones love hearing their own voice played back, so it turns babbling into a game. It's great for tummy time, car trips and nappy changes, and it gets a big reaction as a baby shower gift.
features: Repeats what you say in a funny voice
Sings and sways to the music
Colourful flashing lights
Soft knitted plush with big cartoon eyes, in a cute pot
Runs on 3 x AA batteries
products.age: Check the age rating on the packaging. The battery cover is closed with a screw: keep it closed, always supervise play, and don't leave the toy in a cot.
